title: Root Cause Analysis of Measurement and Mechanistic Anomalies
abstract: arXiv:2601.23026v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Root cause analysis of anomalies aims to identify how and why a sample deviates from the normal process. Existing methods primarily focus on telling which features are responsible, ignoring that anomalies can arise through two fundamentally different processes: measurement errors, where the sample is generated normally but one or more values is recorded incorrectly, and mechanism shifts, where the causal process that generated the sample was changed. While measurement errors can often be safely corrected, mechanistic anomalies require careful consideration. In this paper, we formally define a causal model that explicitly captures both types by treating outliers as latent interventions on latent ("true") and observed ("measured") variables and show under which conditions the distinction is possible. Based on this model, we develop an efficient inference procedure for localizing root causes and distinguishing anomaly types. Experiments

translated_title: 测量异常与机制异常的根本原因分析
translated_abstract: 摘要（arXiv:2601.23026v3，公告类型：替换）：异常的根本原因分析旨在识别样本如何以及为何偏离正常过程。现有方法主要侧重于判断哪些特征对异常负责，却忽略了异常可能通过两种根本不同的过程产生：一是测量误差，即样本本身正常生成，但其中一个或多个数值被错误记录；二是机制偏移，即生成样本的因果过程发生了改变。测量误差通常可以被安全地纠正，而机制异常则需要审慎对待。本文正式定义了一个因果模型，通过将异常值视为对潜在（“真实”）变量与观测（“测量”）变量的潜在干预，显式地刻画了这两类异常，并阐明了在何种条件下能够对二者加以区分。基于该模型，我们开发了一种高效的推理程序，用于定位根本原因并区分异常类型。实验（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个将异常值建模为对潜在“真实”变量与观测“测量”变量之潜在干预的因果模型，首次系统区分了测量误差与机制偏移两类异常，并据此开发了可定位根本原因并判别异常类型的高效推理方法。
en_tdlr: This paper formally defines a causal model that distinguishes measurement errors from mechanism shifts by treating outliers as latent interventions on latent "true" and observed "measured" variables, and develops an efficient inference procedure for localizing root causes and classifying anomaly types.
